programme.sub-title: A Life for North Korea's Leader
programme.desc: North Korea is a country of stark contrasts. On the one hand, it presents real socialist stereotypes like cryptic messages from a frozen time loop, combined with shocking reports on shortages. On the other hand, polished Pyongyang lures with a futuristic skyline, flashy amusement parks and department stores with a range of goods equal to those in western consumer meccas.

programme.title: Signs of Evil
programme.desc: The symbol of the SS, Hitler's Schutzstaffel, stands for terror and the murder of millions. The penniless graphic artist Walter Heck was given the job of designing the jagged, rune-like characters in 1929. The “sig” rune was rooted deep in the ideological cosmos of the Nazis and their supporters. They saw themselves as the descendants of the Teutons and declared the runes to be humanity's original Germanic script. The symbol was meant to unite Heinrich Himmler's “Black Order.” But did it escape their notice that it was originally of Semitic origin? In October 1945, the Allies passed a law banning the Nazi Party and all associated organizations, including the SS. The young Federal Republic even forbade all Nazi symbols. This documentary tells the gripping story of the SS symbol, from the Middle Ages to the present day.

programme.title: Lion
programme.desc: The endless plains of East Africa is a paradise for lions. The most social of all cats, lions form prides that are unlike any other animals. Together, they'll hunt, raise their young and defend their territory. With such a close family and plentiful home, the pride welcomes new babies every year. But new children introduces new dangers. The cubs will have to trust their instincts, their mother and the power of the pride if they are to make it to adulthood and take their place on the African plains.

programme.title: If There Was No Land On Earth
programme.desc: A mesmerizing journey on the border of two amazing worlds - beyond the turquoise waters of Raja Ampat, a paradise of diverse coral gardens, multitudes of fascinating species of fish and towering barrel sponges and up on the land where the unique cultures and ways of life, as well as struggles and triumphs of the people who call this remote and stunning corner of the world home are shown.

programme.title: If There Was No Land On Earth
programme.desc: Discover the breathtaking beauty of the Wayag archipelago and its underwater wonders. From vibrant coral gardens to a diverse array of marine creatures, immerse yourself in the mesmerizing world beneath the surface. Discover how the beautiful pearls are made and meet the dedicated people behind the process. Witness the silky shark's grace and agility in its underwater habitat and learn about the bamboo shark's unique characteristics and behaviors.

programme.title: Hannah Goes to Namibia
programme.desc: Hannah Emde meets one of Africa's most experienced elephant trackers: Hendrick Munembome, the Director of Elephant Human Relations Aid (EHRA).

programme.title: If There Was No Land On Earth
programme.desc: A mesmerizing journey through the pristine waters of Raja Ampat. This Indonesian archipelago is home to some of the most beautiful and diverse marine life on the planet, including colorful fish and majestic Hawksbill Sea turtles. See the sheer beauty and vitality of this incredible ecosystem. From vibrant coral reefs and towering limestone cliffs to the dangerous ocean currents. A true celebration of nature's wonders and a powerful reminder of the importance of preserving our planet's delicate balance.

programme.title: If There Was No Land On Earth
programme.desc: Explore the mesmerizing world of Raja Ampat's underwater nightlife. Witness the stunning trail of underwater mountain peaks and discover the intricate lives of tiny inhabitants like the intriguing Coral Banded shrimps and fashion icons – Decorator crabs. Delve deeper into the mysterious habits of majestic Eagle rays and other incredible sea creatures that call this enchanting place their home. Immerse yourself in a world of wonder and beauty and experience the magic of Raja Ampat's underwater world like never before.

programme.title: Our Big Blue Backyard
programme.desc: Just beyond the Kaikoura Peninsula lies a dramatic, 1200-metre deep canyon supplying nutrient-rich food to a bevy of hungry animals above and underwater. The always-playful Dusky Dolphins, New Zealand Fur Seals, and Red-Billed Gulls take advantage of this bounty at an especially important time of year. It's breeding season, and thousands of Red-Billed Gulls form the largest colony in the South Island. Duskies mate, too, but for fun as well as reproduction. And a Fur Seal finds a magic place while his mother is out at sea.

programme.title: Elephants: Back to the Wild
programme.desc: We follow the rescue of a baby elephant. Once rescued, it will be transported by plane to the breeding station and raised with love and commitment. In order to satisfy the little pachyderm's urge to move while in the breeding station, there is sometimes an adorable football match between the animals.

programme.title: Elephants: Back to the Wild
programme.desc: We accompany the first steps of a two-year-old elephant who is just starting his release program. We also observe the story of two young elephants in their first night in the wilderness on their own. Captivating film footage allows us to truly learn how elephants behave in the wild.

programme.title: Down to Earth
programme.desc: They've given up the wonderful art of flying. Or was it an art they never possessed? The brain structure and anatomy of flightless birds indicate that they descended from "flyers" – so, why don't they fly?

programme.title: Penguin City
programme.desc: In the middle of the Antarctic Ocean, an entire mountain range arises from the water: South Georgia, the nursery of the Antarctic. Hundreds of thousands of penguins, elephant seals, fur seals and their young overcrowd the beaches. The rough weather and the extremely difficult access to the island cause filmmaking to be an endeavor requiring much of the film crew around Roland Gockel and Rosie Koch and the state of the art cameras. A lot of patience and sensitivity over a period spanning some five years now offers unknown and poignant insights into the life of the King Penguins on South Georgia Island

programme.title: Symphony of the Seas
programme.desc: Our journeys take us all around the world from Patagonia to the USA, from Greenland to South Africa and from Cambodia to Australia and leads us to the most fascinating places where landscapes animals and humans are the main focus of our documentaries. Whether on land or at sea – the last paradises of the world are our destination.

programme.title: The Last Paradises: Patagonia
programme.desc: On the wild coast of Patagonia, the nature calendar describes the most diverse visiting times of fascinating animals, from the southern right whale and other large whales, via the sea lions and elephant seals up to the orcas and millions of penguins. The encounters with whales and their babies are spectacular. Hardly anywhere else on earth can one experience both the brutal and the delightful sides of nature so vividly and so close. The trip to the hot spots for animal watchers and researchers leads us inter alia to the Caleta Valdez. This is where, during the mating season, the southern elephant seals bring their babies into the world, mate and enjoy a little sunbathing on the beach.

programme.title: Masai Mara: The Big Hunt
programme.desc: When food supply in the Serengeti dwindles, the Masai Mara is a paradise for predators. As the black wildebeests, gazelles, zebras and antelopes make their yearly trip from the south of the Serengeti to the north, nature's best laid trap, the Mara River in Kenya is waiting ahead. Captivating shots filmed under water show how crocodiles prepare for the Big Hunt while other predators lurk on the banks awaiting their bounty. The biggest problems for the migratory animals are the Mara and the Tarek River, where they have to put their lives at risk to get to the other side. A great number of them die as they jump into the river and break their legs, while others are carried away by the drift or drown. Those who are not victims of the river itself risk falling prey to the crocodiles. We entered this unchartered territory, the crocodile domain by heading under water. Follow these predators in and around their habitat and watch prides of lions map out their game plan. In slow-motion, we show you the final showdown between predator and prey. Will it be a successful hunt or will the hoofed animals persevere?

programme.title: Amazing Iran
programme.desc: For the Iranian Turkmen a wedding is one of most important social events in their culture and is still celebrated according to old nomadic tradition. The Turkmen Steppe, the country of a thousand mountains, is a tribute to the hidden treasure that is Iran. Home to a proud nation with a majestic history, we show the freedom of a nomadic life, encounter the wild nature of the people and discover old traditions like the Turkmen wedding. Breathtaking sceneries create a mysticism that transports viewers into the realm of divinity while exposing a world caught between tradition and modernity - nomadism and sedentarism. Weddings in Iran are primarily arrangements between families and the product of lengthy negotiations. Even though many customs are purely symbolic, they still reflect the great significance as a rite of transition for the newlyweds and their families. The life of the Turkmen housewife revolves around weddings – first her own, later those of her children. Raising healthy, capable daughters and sons searching for possible partners mediating contact negotiating each betrothal with the family of the intended shouldering the wedding arrangements and the observance of customs and traditions – the responsibility for all of that falls to the mother. Though the Turkmen daughters and sons of today do insist on having their say, love, affection, trust and the like are still not the decisive criteria in making a match. The main consideration is not the subjective happiness of the couple but the happiness, stability and honor of each of their families as a whole. So it is still not uncommon for the bride and groom to be virtual strangers on their wedding day. The nuptials as a ritual of transition mark a series of profound changes – especially in the life of the bride. Once married, she leaves her family and her home village to take her new place within the family of the groom.

programme.title: Amazing Isfahan
programme.sub-title: Paradise in the Heart of Iran
programme.desc: Take a look at this natural beauty. Isfahan – the Florence of Persia, the blue pearl of Iran. The city in the heart of Iran is the most charismatic city in the country and often uttered in the same breath as Bagdad, Constantinople or Cairo. The former capital of the Persian Safavid Empire has long since lost the status of cosmopolitan city, but it still radiates a cosmopolitan charm of which the inhabitants are extremely proud. With its Iranian and Persian national consciousness, Isfahan emits a form of comeliness that attracts people near and far. Following the 30-year-old carpet dealer Shanty as he tries to establish a business for himself and his fiancée Nina, we discover the soul of the city with mesmeric shots, intimate portraits and true to life portrayals of daily life. For 120 years his family has been dealing with noble Persian carpets, but Shanty dreams of a modern coffee shop, driven by a youthful eagerness to experiment and with passion for the new. In the cozy little espresso bar on the city's famous Imam Square Shanty's barista conjures up the best créma in Isfahan while Pink Floyd, The Grateful Death and Led Zeppelin boom from the loudspeakers nothing new in Berlin or Paris but almost revolutionary here. In intimate pictures, we accompany the youngest son of an old Isfahan family through his bulging everyday life and see how many young Iranians try to unite the culture and traditions of their country with the present.

programme.title: Seychelles
programme.desc: A vacation in the Seychelles - or even a wedding? This is the dream for many, especially Germans, who top the guest list at this island archipelago. But the paradise is under threat. We show the beauty of the island, with its rare animal species, happy wedding couples and white beaches. And yet: This is a paradise under threat, you can see the signs of climate change, with broken shorelines and bleached corals. Although the Seychelles has only 0.13 percent of Germany's land area, its new marine reserve is larger than the Federal Republic: A dream for the conservationists, who are supported by the Seychelles government.

programme.title: Berlin from Above
programme.desc: Unique pictures from above. This documentary shows a different angle of people and country, during a glide flight above the metropolis. More than 25 years after the reunion between East and West Germany, this movie shows pictures from different perspectives. Which visions and dreams marked this region? What changed and what emerged in Germany's tensed city. We take a look from above to see the city and its citizens. Due to high quality flight recordings and panorama pictures, we are able to see how the people make this area their home. The movie unites nature, urbanity, tranquility and the rush of a metropolis. It unites parks and skyscraper canyons, lake capes and wetlands, curvy courses of rivers and straight streets. With exhilarating pictures we take a trip through Berlin- from sunrise til sunset. Due to high quality flight recordings and panorama pictures, we are able to get a glimpse at how the people make this area their home.

programme.title: Thunderstox
programme.desc: Jestro and the Cloud of Monstrox encounters the sculptor. He helps unleash a horde of fierce garden gnomes on Knighton. What will the NEXO KNIGHTS do against this new enemy? Will their new COMBO NEXO Powers do the trick? As Jestro and the Cloud of Monstrox head off on the Evil Mobile to 'store' the Forbidden Power in a secret location, they encounter…THE SCULPTOR. His real name is ROBERTO ARNOLDI. He's a sensitive and odd artist who has been laid off by the king (the King ordered a "smashing" statue of the Queen, and the Sculptor made a statue of the Queen literally smashing monsters. He takes everything very literally.) Jestro instructs him to make a "bad" statue that he can use to attack the knights. The Sculptor sets to work. Meanwhile, the NEXO KNIGHTS are discussing the COMBO NEXO Powers, the Forbidden Powers, and what all this means. Lance, meanwhile, decides that since his talk show career is on hold, he thinks he'll install cameras in the Fortrex and do a Big Brother-like expose show on the Knights (he decides NOT to tell the others.) Merlok 2.0 and the Cloud of Monstrox (each talking to their cohorts) explain the history of the Forbidden Powers: it's a history lesson about the WIZARDS' COUNCIL, the Forbidden Powers, and how they were stopped long ago. This visual montage leads Jestro to…MOUNT THUNDERSTROX. The Cloud of Monstrox shows him the circle of ten Standing Stones where he will insert the Forbidden Powers. "What'll happen after that?” asks Jestro, curious. "Oh, I don't want to spoil the surprise," says the Cloud. They insert the first Forbidden Power, Relentless Rust, and it locks into place on its stone. They go off to battle the Knights and collect the "bad" statue the sculptor is making. But he's made a literally bad statue…it's terrible ... garden gnomes. Like an amateur art student. And…it's not even finished. ("You can't rush bad genius!") The Knights attack with their newly modified vehicles and they succeed in destroying the Evil Mobile. They then try to use a COMBO NEXO Power, but can't…it had to be perfect to work (Ava and Merlok need to work on it.) As Jestro and the Cloud retreat, Merlok again talks to Clay about turning to stone! Merlok calls in Robin…he will need him to build something to help Clay as he becomes more and more impaired.

programme.title: Weekend At Halberts
programme.desc: Party time in Knighton! The mood is down so the King decides to throw a party. In the meantime Jestro attacks the Fortrex, but he is confronted with the new NEXO Power "The Wedgie of Doom". Clay is turned to stone and everyone is gloomy. Especially King Halbert. In order to get everything in a better mood Aaron organizes a celebration. The King wants a reenactment of Clay's heroic rescue of the Queen. He is (as usual) totally unaware of Clay's situation. In order not to disappoint him further, the Knights get a remote control for Clay's Battle suit and is thus able to “perform” as Clay. Lance is happy to exercise his acting abilities and quickly gets into the role of the uptight knight of knights. Ava is working on reinstalling Merlok 2.0 into the Fortrex with Robin. She is also preparing the Fortrex for a visit from the new Knights' Academy novices. It is a fieldtrip with Principal Brickland and Sir Griffiths with the goal of teaching the kids about these new so-called High-tech battle strategies. Not really feeling it for anything modern, it quickly turns into a regular trip back memory lane for Brickland and Sir Griffiths. This out of control excursion is an excellent moment for Jestro who is looking for an opportunity to cheer up the defeated Monstrox. Unfortunately, for Jestro, Ava is able to make Merlok 2.0 functional again, and the Novices are able to fight Jestro and his monsters off using the NEXO Power: Wedgie of Doom. It is a humiliating defeat. Apparently, this is just what the doctor ordered for Monstrox. A good laugh at someone else's expense. His evil mood is back on.

programme.title: Awakening
programme.desc: When Mateo's comic creation, Z-Blob, follows him from a dream back to Brooklyn, Mateo and his sister realize the Dream World is real, and in danger!

programme.title: Dream Chasers
programme.desc: After a daring mission to save their friend in the Dream World, Mateo and Izzie find the nightmare has followed them back to the Waking World.

programme.title: Legacy, Vehicle and Mechs
programme.desc: Zane takes help from Nya for backup memories of their adventures to the Samurai X Cave computer, but Zane encounters a mysterious puzzle buried deep within his code. Nya digitizes Jay and uploads him into Zane's mind. Jay reviews memories of the Ninja's various motorcycles, mechs and planes in order to solve the vehicle-themed puzzle.

programme.title: The Oni And The Dragon
programme.desc: While Princess Harumi learns to adjust to the life of a Ninja, Lloyd and Jay search for answers about the Oni Masks at Mystake's Tea house, while Cole and Zane attempt to infiltrate the Sons of Garmadon biker gang. Remembering that Lloyd managed to arrest one of the gang members at Borg Tower, the Ninja decide to interrogate him to ascertain the location of the third Oni Mask. In order to get him to talk, however, Cole suggests they visit MYSTAKE'S TEA HOUSE to obtain some "truth tea." The truth-tea backfires spectacularly when Cole accidentally switches cups and drinks the tea himself. Zane is able to salvage the situation, however, and obtains a lead. He learns that the Sons of Garmadon frequent a karaoke bar called LAUGHY'S. Zane and Cole don disguises to infiltrate the bar. Cole assumes the alter ego “Rocky Dangerbuff," while Zane adopts the subtler moniker "Snake Jaguar." In order to earn the gang's trust, Cole performs a karaoke routine that is a smash success. Unfortunately, during the routine, his disguise comes loose and he is exposed as a ninja. The Sons of Garmadon attack him, and Zane (who is still in disguise) is unable to intervene. Cole is taken prisoner while Zane is invited back to the Sons of Garmadon's secret base.

programme.title: The Pranks
programme.desc: Stephanie finds the perfect front page story for the school paper! It's almost too good to be true. Emma and Andrea go undercover to solve the mystery of the two Jacobs.The friends are using their talents to pull a prank on Olivia. But who gets the last laugh?

programme.title: Spooky Sensation
programme.desc: The girls decided to spend a weekend at the hotel. It appears to be haunted. Watch the full video to know more about this.

programme.title: Sings of Love
programme.desc: See how Stephanie and Olivia enter the Under the Sea photo competition. Jacob wrote a love song! Olivia and her friends are very excited to hear. Tanya and Stephanie are teamed up in baking class. Watch the video for more fun.

programme.title: Video Wonder
programme.desc: Olivia and Andrea visited science camp with Mrs Stevens. On the other hand, Andrea and Mia decides to return a lost skunk to nature. Andrea was reading intimate postcards between Chef Pierre and Mrs. Stevens.

programme.title: Stiix and Stones
programme.desc: The Ninja travel to the Village of Stiix to find the thief who stole the scroll of Airjitzu, but the self-serving Ronan isn't keen to sell it cheaply so the Ninja must figure out a way to make money on the docks – and when they fail to make enough cash, the Ninja decide to steal it – but have a run in with Moro and Sowlarcha. The Ninja travel to the Village of Stiix to find the thief who stole the scroll of Airjitzu, but when the self-serving Ronan isn't keen to sell it cheaply, the Ninja must figure out a way to make money on the docks. Meanwhile, reluctant to give up being Samurai X, Nya struggles to embrace being a Water Ninja, and Sensei Wu gives her a riddle to figure out. Back at Stiix, when the Ninja fail to make enough cash working the docks, the Ninja decide to steal it... but have a run in with Moro and Sowlarcha. After Moro gets away with the scroll, the Ninja are left dangling, but Ronan saves them at a price – for a piece of their share in the Tea Farm.

programme.title: Public Enemy Number One
programme.desc: The Ninja must find out as much as they can about Nadakhan before he finds the Realm Crystal to save his crew, but after the Ninja are labeled enemies by the world they used to protect, our heroes find themselves hunted by their old friend, Ronan. With the Destiny's Bounty impounded, the police hire Ronin to track down the fugitive ninja. Misako has been arrested and is confronted by Nadakhan, who reveals he has trapped Wu in the Teapot of Tyrahn. Misako accidentally reveals the location of the Realm Crystal. The ninja discover that Wu was researching djinn when he disappeared and split up to learn more about their potential new foe. Lloyd and Zane head to the Library of Domu. While there, Ronin hacks into Zane's systems and shuts him down, then captures Lloyd. Ronin uses Zane's SOS beacon to lure Kai and Nya into the desert, where they are captured. Later, Cole and Jay are defeated by Ronin as well. Meanwhile, Nadakhan has used his powers to foil the high-tech security guarding the Realm Crystal and steals it. The ninja are hauled off to Kryptarium Prison and Nadakhan is free to gather his lost crew.

programme.title: Enkrypted
programme.desc: Nadakhan vows revenge on the ninja and NINJAGO. The ninja and Soto escape from jail, only to find out the map to the island is on Nadakhan's ship. Nadakhan discovers that Nya looks just like Delara, his long-lost love.Falsely imprisoned, the Ninja are at their lowest point, but find an unlikely friend in an old enemy. Meanwhile, Nadakhan rescues his marooned crew and gains a new perspective, along with a new mysterious plan. With the ninja imprisoned, Nadakhan uses the Realm Crystal to free his old crew. The ninja encounter Captain Soto, the first captain of the Destiny's Bounty, who tells them the story of how he originally trapped Nadakhan in the Teapot. The secret, he says, is the venom of a Tiger Widow, a rare creature that lives on only one island. The venom can slow a djinn down. Soto is the only one who knows where the island is and will only tell if the ninja break him out of jail. Meanwhile, Nadakhan has decided to return to his home realm of Djinjago, only to discover it is falling apart. The ninja's destruction of the Cursed Realm is affecting the realms connected to it. Nadakhan uses the Djinn Blade to smash the Teapot, absorbing all the spirits that were trapped there into the sword.

programme.title: Misfortune Rising
programme.desc: The ninja's search for Nadakhan's ship turns up nothing. Nadakhan's crew is struggling to handle an airship which used to sail only on the oceans. Nadakhan confronts Jay and talks him into making a wish that will win him Nya. Jay wishes that he wasn't born in a junkyard and was rich. The next moment, he receives a letter saying his father has died and he has inherited his estate. Jay rushes home to find his parents in the junkyard and finds out they are fine, but they reveal that he is adopted. Jay discovers that his real father is the actor who played his favorite movie hero. In an effort to trap the ninja, the Sky Pirates start raids all over NINJAGO City. Nadakhan kidnaps Kai, who makes two wishes, both of which go wrong. His third wish is to “make it all go away.” Nadakhan's first mate, Flintlocke, accidentally destroys the Realm Crystal and Cole steals Soto's map. The Destiny's Bounty mysteriously vanishes from the police impound yard.The Ninja are on a collision course to find the map to stop Nadakhan, they first must find him. Meanwhile, Jay makes a wish to change his future, but it could alter his past indefinitely.

programme.title: The Cloud
programme.desc: A storm is brewing over Knighton. Monstrox has taken the form of a cloud, and is raising an army of lightning infused Stone Monsters. His first target is the new Lavalands Amusement Park. Harmony reigns in Knighton as the Knights pursue their civilian lives: Lance has a TV talk show Axl is the singing chef on the show Jestro is the weatherman Clay is teaching at the Knights' Academy Macy, Ava and Merlok 2.0 travel the land in the Fortrex making sure the kingdom's defenses are ready (part of a plan she and Clay have) Aaron and his hover shield is travelling the land setting extreme records. Robin is at his workshop at the Knights' Academy doing an “independent study” – he's working on some top secret project for Merlok 2.0. It all seems excellent! We even see the Knights new vehicles – which have been optimized for civilian life (except for Clay's.) But storm clouds are brewing. Well, one storm cloud is brewing: the Cloud of Monstrox! Yes, the Book of Monsters has reconstituted himself and is now a cloud who needs a man on the ground to enact his new evil plan. He follows his old buddy Jestro as he goes across the realm on the weekends apologizing for being evil. ZAP! With one bolt of his evil magic lighting, the Cloud of Monstrox turns Jestro evil again (only this time a bit, well, too evil.) The evil duo are back together – and bring stone to life for the first time in the form of Gargoyles from the town of GHOULIA. Now they must gather the Forbidden Powers so that the Cloud of Monstrox can destroy the entire kingdom! A battle breaks out in the Lava Lands, where Lance and Alice Squires are reporting from the opening of the Cuthbert Richmond funded Lava Lands Amusement Park, rebuilt from the remains of Jestro's old HQ. Jestro and the Cloud are after something in the remains and as Merlok 2.0 sends out a call for the Knights to help Lance. Can Lance (with an assist from King Halbert in his Mech) hold-off Jestro, the Cloud and their new army of stone fighters?!

programme.title: A Little Rusty
programme.desc: The Cloud of Monstrox and Jestro unlocks a mysterious Forbidden Power. What kind ofhavoc will they unleash? And can Merlok 2.0 and the NEXO KNIGHTS make the new COMBO NEXO Powers work? The Knights finally make it to the Lava Lands – using their various new forms of transport, which are all strictly civilian vechicles – and they must regroup and learn to fight together again to face the new threat of Jestro, the Cloud of Monstrox, and their STONE MONSTERS (in this case, Stone Gargoyles.) But Jestro and his monsters beat back the knights and recover the STAFF OF MONSTROX – which was buried under the ceremonial chamber from Episode 210 (and is now the Lava Puker amusement park ride) – and they get away on Jestro's EVIL MOBILE, which he recovers from the HQ garage. Macy says this is exactly why she's been touring the kingdom preparing everyone for the next attack. The Knights have to get it together because now the entire kingdom is under threat…again. Robin decides he must upgrade the Knights' vehicles and make them more “fight optimized.” Ava and Merlok 2.0 must figure out how to use new NEXO Powers because regular NEXO Powers do make Stone monsters back into stone, but the Cloud simply zaps them to life again. Meanwhile, in the IRON MOUNTAINS, Jestro and the Cloud of Monstrox find the first of the Forbidden Powers: RELENTLESS RUST. They find the ROGUL STATUE holding the power and zap him to life. Now…they can rust those shiny knights to pieces! Ava and Merlok are attempting to use NEXO COMBO POWERS – with hilarious results – as they try to figure out how they might work. When Jestro attacks, he's able to halt the Fortrex by instantly rusting its tracks and wheels! Robin has his hands full trying to clean all the rust from the attack of Relentless Rust. As the Knights attempt to defend against Jestro, the Cloud is zapping statues to life. He hits a statue with a bolt of lightning as Clay is touching it. Something happens…Clay feels odd stiff as if rock is mixing with his body. Finally, Ava and Merlok 2.0 download to the Knights their new thing: a COMBO NEXO COMBO Power. It works! It can smash the animated statues to dust! They use it to defeat Jestro, but he and the Cloud get away with the Forbidden Power of Relentless Rust. Victory … sort of. Clay talks to Merlok 2.0…something has happened to him. What can they do? Merlok 2.0 is very concerned.

programme.title: Thunderstox
programme.desc: Jestro and the Cloud of Monstrox encounters the sculptor. He helps unleash a horde of fierce garden gnomes on Knighton. What will the NEXO KNIGHTS do against this new enemy? Will their new COMBO NEXO Powers do the trick? As Jestro and the Cloud of Monstrox head off on the Evil Mobile to 'store' the Forbidden Power in a secret location, they encounter…THE SCULPTOR. His real name is ROBERTO ARNOLDI. He's a sensitive and odd artist who has been laid off by the king (the King ordered a "smashing" statue of the Queen, and the Sculptor made a statue of the Queen literally smashing monsters. He takes everything very literally.) Jestro instructs him to make a "bad" statue that he can use to attack the knights. The Sculptor sets to work. Meanwhile, the NEXO KNIGHTS are discussing the COMBO NEXO Powers, the Forbidden Powers, and what all this means. Lance, meanwhile, decides that since his talk show career is on hold, he thinks he'll install cameras in the Fortrex and do a Big Brother-like expose show on the Knights (he decides NOT to tell the others.) Merlok 2.0 and the Cloud of Monstrox (each talking to their cohorts) explain the history of the Forbidden Powers: it's a history lesson about the WIZARDS' COUNCIL, the Forbidden Powers, and how they were stopped long ago. This visual montage leads Jestro to…MOUNT THUNDERSTROX. The Cloud of Monstrox shows him the circle of ten Standing Stones where he will insert the Forbidden Powers. "What'll happen after that?” asks Jestro, curious. "Oh, I don't want to spoil the surprise," says the Cloud. They insert the first Forbidden Power, Relentless Rust, and it locks into place on its stone. They go off to battle the Knights and collect the "bad" statue the sculptor is making. But he's made a literally bad statue…it's terrible ... garden gnomes. Like an amateur art student. And…it's not even finished. ("You can't rush bad genius!") The Knights attack with their newly modified vehicles and they succeed in destroying the Evil Mobile. They then try to use a COMBO NEXO Power, but can't…it had to be perfect to work (Ava and Merlok need to work on it.) As Jestro and the Cloud retreat, Merlok again talks to Clay about turning to stone! Merlok calls in Robin…he will need him to build something to help Clay as he becomes more and more impaired.

The Wolf saw this and was glad as he hoped to get some fish, but the Fox told the Wolf that it's her own fisherman and if he wants to eat some fish - he should put in his own tail in an ice-hole. programme.desc: Are you afraid of monsters? Sure you are! Let me tell you a scary story about a boy who experienced a real fear…This story happened on an abandoned tractor factory. The boy lost a scoop from his toy-tractor and decided to look for it at the factory. So he goes up the stairs and sees a large female monster, who was about to paint her lips with a roller! As he kept walking he noticed more monsters playing domino! The boy was very terrified and about to cry, when he learnt that it was just a movie set and all the monsters were not real! They were just actors…Finally the boy realized that all the monsters from the books and movies are not real at all! But if want to see a real monster- watch a fly under a microscope!

programme.title: The Wolf and the Fox
programme.desc: Once upon a time there lived a fisherman with his wife. Nearby there lived the Fox. One day the man went to a frozen pond to fish. On his way he found the Fox, who pretended to be dead, and picked her up. The Man started to fish and fell asleep over an ice-hole. The Wolf saw this and was glad as he hoped to get some fish, but the Fox told the Wolf that it's her own fisherman and if he wants to eat some fish - he should put in his own tail in an ice-hole. The Wolf's tail froze in the ice and fishes made a cute Christmas tree out of it. The Man, his Wife, the Fox, the Cat and the Mouse finally pulled the Wolf's tail out of the hole and the New Year has finally come.

programme.title: The Wolf and the Seven Young Kids
programme.desc: This educative tale teaches us that caution should never be dismissed. Mother-Goat goes to pick up cabbage, leaving her seven kids alone at home. Hungry Wolf tries to get into the house imitating mother Goat's voice to fool the little yeanlings. He manages to deceive six kids, but the seventh, the smallest one, manages to hide in the oven. The Wolf tries to get into the house through the chimney, but here comes Mother-Goat and finds her seventh kid. She melts the stove, and the Wolf rushes into the forest with his tail burnt. The other six kids come back home and finally the family reunites.

programme.title: The Fox and the Rolling Pin
programme.desc: This is the story about the Fox, the Cat and the Rooster. The sneaky Fox wanted to fool the Cat in order to eat the Rooster and get a rolling-pin. No matter how the Fox tried to butter up the Cat, he denied hand over the Rooster to the Fox. To teach her a lesson, the Cat got into a bag himself and when the Fox opened it in order to eat the Rooster, the Cat jumped out of it and frightened her. The point of the story is that “if you are well off you don't seek better”.

programme.desc: With the luxury saloon EQS and the sporty executive saloon EQE, Mercedes-Benz has entered a new, all-electric era in the upper market segments as well. The EQS SUV, the third model series with this architecture developed for electric vehicles, will soon follow. The SUV offers plenty of space, comfort and connectivity for up to seven passengers in its avant-garde, luxurious interior. Thanks to powerful electric motors, responsive 4MATIC all-wheel drive and an intelligent OFFROAD driving mode, the EQS SUV is also capable of tackling light terrain with ease. The new EQS SUV shares the long wheelbase (3210 millimetres) with the EQS Saloon, but is over 20 centimetres higher. The dimensions in detail: 5125/1959/1718 millimetres (length/width/height). The interior dimensions benefit from these generous SUV dimensions and from the advantages of the purpose design tailored to the electric platform. The second row of seats can be electrically adjusted as standard. Up to four golf bags fit in the boot. A third row of seats with two additional individual seats and extensive comfort features for all passengers is available as an option.

programme.title: Colour change with the power of thought
programme.sub-title: The BMW iX Flow meets neuro-technology - Colour change with the power of thought - The BMW iX Flow meets neuro-technology
programme.desc: The Munich-based startup brainboost used the new and improved colour-changing effect in a one-off collaboration with the BMW Group at rad°hub aimed at raising awareness of mental health. With the help of brainboost, the BMW iX Flow was connected directly to the brain of the rad°hub delegates using an electroencephalograph (EEG), which records the brain's electrical activity. “The colour patterns of the BMW iX Flow react to brain activity and reflect the level of activity,” explains brainboost CEO Philipp Heiler. “Once the brain is at rest, the changes of patterns on the iX Flow also become calmer and more rhythmical.” A special animation was activated if delegates managed to maintain this state for several seconds. Thus, the participants were able to gradually calm and relax their brains under the guidance of the brainboost experts and with the help of neurofeedback via the iX Flow. This matures the knowledge of which strategies work best to specifically shut down one's own brain activity for relaxation, e.g. in everyday working life.

programme.desc: To celebrate the arrival of the new Bentayga EWB, an exclusive First Edition is now available. Subject to a limited production run for the first twelve months of orders, it combines many of the most desirable options available for the car with a package of eye-catching details found only on Bentley First Editions. First Edition badging can be seen to the exterior of the car – a theme that extends inside, with badging on the veneered fascia, as well as embroidery on the seats. Unique First Edition contrast stitching and embroidery adorns the seats and, depending on the choice of veneers, handcrafted metal overlays just 0.075 mm thick can be applied to the fascia and waistrails in the front and the rear door veneer. The First Edition offers elegant and timeless design, focusing on maximum comfort and well-being. This specifically tailored specification includes a unique 22” ten-spoke directional wheel and bright lower bumper grilles. Other additional features as standard include unique quilted seats, mood lighting, a heated steering wheel, and increased driver's assistance aids. Attention to detail is clear, from the badging that identifies the car to the jewelled caps on the fuel and oil fillers.

Zero to 100 km/h takes just 3.3 seconds (911 Carrera 4 GTS: Fuel consumption combined (NEDC) 10.5 – 9.7 l/100 km, Fuel consumption combined (WLTP) 11.4 – 10.6 l/100 km, CO₂ emissions combined (NEDC) 240 – 222 g/km, CO₂ emissions combined (WLTP) 259 – 240 g/km) in the 911 Carrera 4 GTS Coupé with the eight-speed Porsche dual-clutch transmission (PDK): three tenths faster than its predecessor. programme.title: From concept vehicle to full-production ID
programme.sub-title: From concept vehicle to full-production ID. Buzz - How was the electric Microbus created
programme.desc: The new model line's assistance systems perfect ease of driving and safety. Included as standard in the ID. Buzz and ID. Buzz Cargo is the ‘Car2X' local warning system, which utilises signals from other vehicles and the transport infrastructure to spot hazards in real time. Also included as standard: the ‘Front Assist' emergency braking function and, in the MPV, the ‘Lane Assist' lane-keeping assistant. With new software, new assistance functions are also making their way into the ID. family. Available as an option is ‘Travel Assist with swarm data', which facilitates partially automated driving across the entire speed range and, for the first time, assisted lane-changing on the motorway. Also new: the ‘Memory Function' for automated parking on a previously saved route.

programme.title: New 2023 Range Rover Sport Product Highlights_en
programme.sub-title: New 2023 Range Rover Sport Design Reveal Film
programme.desc: The New Range Rover Sport has made its global premiere with a dramatic world-first climb up a flooded dam spillway in Iceland. The epic ascent saw New Range Rover Sport resist the surging torrent of water flowing down the ramp of the Karahnjukar Dam – the biggest of its kind in the world – at a rate of 750 tonnes per minute. A loss of traction risked plunging down the perilous 90m drop at the base of the spillway to the valley floor below. The successful spillway ascent was screened for the first time at an exclusive launch event at Jaguar Land Rover's Advanced Product Creation Centre at Gaydon, UK. Official James Bond stunt driver Jessica Hawkins was behind the wheel as the New Range Rover Sport demonstrated its grip, traction, performance and composure, completing the latest in a series of challenges for Land Rover's luxury performance SUV. Previous feats include a record-setting hill-climb at Pikes Peak, a first recorded crossing of the ‘Empty Quarter' desert in the Arabian Peninsula and a first ascent of the 999 steps to Heaven's Gate in China, in 2018.

programme.title: Hispano Suiza showcases its history in the Peralada Castle Museum
programme.desc: The history of Hispano Suiza is showcased, for the very first time, in the Peralada Castle Museum (Girona, Spain) where visitors will be able to contemplate the past and present of the legendary car brand founded in 1904 by Damián Mateu and Mark Birkigt. The Hispano Suiza Room will close the usual tour of the Peralada Castle Museum. After years of researching to gather the largest number of pieces and objects related to its history, Hispano Suiza becomes part of this important collection. The Hispano Suiza exhibition encompasses a journey through various decades: from the beginning of the 20th century, when Hispano Suiza was founded, to the present day. After passing through a luxurious hall, the public will be able to visit a recreation of the offices of Damián Mateu and Mark Birkigt, where countless business and technical ideas, emerged and took shape, turning Hispano Suiza into a point of reference, for luxury, comfort and technical solutions. In this area, the original painting 'Dame with a mink' by Ramon Casas takes pride of place: it was used as an illustration on the company's original shares.

programme.title: TechDay Digital Light
programme.sub-title: Digital Future Lighting - TechDay Digital Light - Digital Future Lighting
programme.desc: Safety and customer satisfaction come first at Audi. They are part and parcel of the success of the company with the four rings. In that context, light technology is steadily growing more important and creating a wider range of possibilities and perspectives, from added safety for the driver, to external communication and individualization. Systematic light digitization is making all of this possible. It is particularly visible in the new Audi A8: the forward-looking Digital Matrix LED headlights and digital OLED rear lights raise the customer experience to a whole new level: for the first time in any Audi model, light is completely digitized. The car can be individualized even further through its digital OLED rear lights. The Digital Matrix LED headlights also include three new functions: advanced traffic information, a lane light with direction indicator lights on highways, and an orientation light on country roads. These features not only demonstrate Audi's “Vorsprung durch Technik,” they also add value.

programme.desc: The sixth generation Opel/Vauxhall Astra and third generation Peugeot 308 are both based on the Stellantis EMP2 platform and, unsurprisingly, score very similarly across all four areas of assessment. Ben presto viene conteso dalla padrona di casa, dalle sue amiche e dalle altre cameriere. Si aprono per lui le porte per una veloce scalata sociale, ma le cose non andranno esattamente come previsto...

programme.title: Letti sbagliati

Quattro divertenti episodi che ruotano intorno al piacere: due sono ambientati in un treno, all'interno del quale si verificano eventi indimenticabili, uno in un caldo ascensore bloccato e l'ultimo riguarda un vedovo, ossessionato dal precedente matrimonio.

programme.title: Letti selvaggi

programme.title: La città sconvolta: caccia spietata ai rapitori

Quando i rapitori uccidono Fabrizio, suo padre Mario (Luc Merenda), inizia la sua spieteta vendetta. Regia di Fernando Di Leo.

programme.title: Totò, Peppino e la… Malafemmina

Totò e Peppino sono due buffi zii di uno studente innamorato di una ballerina. Lei, che non gode di buona fama, si trasferisce a Milano e il ragazzo la segue. Inizia il viaggio degli zii alla volta della Lombardia.

programme.title: Le cameriere

Senza accorgersene viene derubata da un affascinante uomo di cui la ragazza non ricorda il nome. Dopo essere stata denunciata per furto, insieme alle sue amiche, darà la caccia al misterioso seduttore per dimostrare la sua innocenza.

programme.title: Questa volta parliamo di uomini
programme.desc: Grande classico del cinema italiano diretto dal Premio Oscar Lina Wertmüller e interpretato da personalità di spicco tra cui Nino Manfredi, Luciana Paluzzi e Margaret Lee. Il film, suddiviso in quattro episodi, vede come protagonisti un industriale in crisi finanziaria, un lanciatore di coltelli disperato, un contadino che disprezza la propria moglie e una donna esasperata dal marito.

programme.title: Una storia moderna: l'ape regina

Il quarantenne Alfonso riesce finalmente a sposare Regina, vergine, educata, bella e molto cattolica. Quando Regina inizia a mettergli pressione perché vuole avere un bambino, l'uomo si ammala e, raggiunto l'obiettivo, Regina inizierà a trascurarlo fino a causare un drammatico evento.

programme.title: Splendori e Miserie di Madame Royale
programme.desc: Alessio, ex ballerino omosessuale, ha solo due consolazioni, la figlia adottiva e i momenti in cui si traveste con sontuosi abiti femminili e si fa chiamare Madame Royale, durante le festicciole con gli amici. Un giorno la figlia finisce nei guai e un losco commissario promette al ballerino di proscioglierla se accetterà di diventare una spia della polizia.

programme.title: La grande abbuffata
programme.desc: In una villa fuori Parigi quattro vecchi amici si riuniscono per un week-end abbandonandosi ad un`orgia di cibo e sesso. Uno di loro, Marcello, porta con sé alcune prostitute che disgustate dall`ambiente se ne andranno. Ad un certo punto una maestra va lì per caso con in suoi alunni in visita al giardino della villa, rimane affascinata dai quattro e decide di fare ritorno unendosi a loro nel folle e autodistruttivo fine settimana...

programme.title: Ciao maschio
programme.desc: Il rifiuto della paternità e la scelta di adottare come figlio una scimmietta saranno per il protagonista, Lafayette , l'ultima e delirante affermazione di individualità.

programme.title: L'orchestra rossa
programme.desc: L`orchestra rossa è la più importante rete di spie della seconda guerra mondiale. Si tratta di una storia incredibile ma assolutamente vera, che ricostruisce come un manipolo di audaci non professionisti di diverse nazionalità, senza alcuna esperienza sul campo, sia riuscito a tenere in scacco i nazisti sottraendo informazioni segretissime persino durante le riunioni di Hitler con i suoi generali

programme.title: I segreti di Brokeback Mountain
programme.desc: Due cowboy, Ennis e Jack, si incontrano su Brokeback Mountain e vivono un amore segreto che segnerà le loro vite per sempre, tra passioni soffocate e il peso delle convenzioni sociali.

programme.title: Preludio alla guerra
programme.desc: Il film si apre su una parata delle forze armate americane. La voce narrante chiede «Perché gli americani sono in marcia?». Risponde elencando una serie di teatri di guerra (Pearl Harbor, Gran Bretagna, Francia, Cina, Cecoslovacchia, Norvegia, Paesi Bassi, Polonia, Grecia, Belgio, Albania, Jugoslavia, Russia), mentre vengono mostrate immagini di guerra e distruzione.

programme.title: Stalag 17
programme.desc: In un campo di prigionia tedesco dove sono rinchiusi alcuni militari americani, un tentativo di fuga di alcuni prigionieri viene sventato. Nasce il sospetto che una spia si nasconda fra loro ed i sospetti all'inizio convergono su Sedgewick, un cinico sergente che tratta con i soldati tedeschi per poter avere speciali privilegi, ma dopo essere stato picchiato, Sedgewick stesso è determinato a scoprire il vero traditore.

programme.title: XX secolo
programme.desc: Un fiammante impresario di Broadway che è caduto in difficoltà cerca di convincere la sua ex amante, ora una diva di Hollywood, a tornare e far risorgere la sua carriera fallimentare.

programme.title: UN AMORE A GONFIE VELE
programme.desc: Da Miami ai Caraibi dopo aver ereditato una barca, Lorelei aiutata da Rob farà tornare la barca al suo splendore. Alla fine, Lorelei tornerà a Miami?

programme.title: IL CLUB DELL'AMORE: IL SOGNO DI LAUREN
programme.desc: Il sogno di Lauren è aprire una galleria d'arte. Dopo aver lasciato il marito che la tratteneva nella sua ascesa, l'incontro con Peter le porta nuova linfa.

programme.title: LA MACCHINA DEI DESIDERI
programme.desc: Quando il suo desiderio di compleanno richiama magicamente il bizzarro attore di Hollywood Drake nella sua piccola città del Midwest, Sophie deve capire come aiutarlo a integrarsi fino a quando non riuscirà a rimandarlo a casa. Ma Drake è più interessato ad aiutare Sophie a farsi notare.

programme.title: Ritorno al Lago
programme.desc: Dopo la perdita del padre, due sorelle si riuniscono nella villa al lago di famiglia e scoprono che il segreto per superare la tragedia è ricostruire la speranza sta nel guardarsi nel profondo

programme.title: L'AGENDA DELL'AMORE
programme.desc: Hazel sta lanciando un prodotto per incoraggiare il piacere dell'organizzazione, ma si blocca quando deve promuoverlo in un programma mattutino di Boston. Theo, che è un conduttore di quiz, accetta di aiutarla a prepararsi per la sua seconda occasione nel programma.

programme.title: Little big soldier
programme.desc: Un soldato della dinastia Liang si risveglia sul campo di battaglia dopo essersi finto morto. L'unico altro sopravvissuto è un giovane generale di Wei che decide di rapire non sapendo che è l'erede al trono e suo fratello lo cerca per ucciderlo!

programme.title: Istruzioni non incluse
programme.desc: Valentin è un playboy di Acapulco. Un giorno sulla sua porta viene lasciata una bambina e l'uomo decide di crescerla come fosse sua, cambiando così stile di vita ed arrivando a conquistare Hollywood come stuntman.

programme.title: Mozart and the whale
programme.desc: Donald e Isabel sono affetti dalla sindrome di Asperger. Gli stravolgerà la vita e lui non potrà che innamorarsene perdutamente.

programme.title: Totòtruffa 62
programme.desc: Antonio e Felice sono due simpatiche canaglie che, grazie alla capacità di travestirsi, tirano avanti con furti e piccoli raggiri. Il tutto per mantenere Diana, figlia di Antonio, in un lussuoso collegio.

programme.title: La casa del diavolo
programme.desc: Sequel del sanguinoso 'La casa dei mille corpi', la psicotica famiglia Firefly vaga senza meta, lasciando sulla strada una scia di morte e distruzione. È, però, braccata da uno sceriffo feroce e due cacciatori di taglie senza scrupoli: la caccia sarà spietata.

programme.title: La settima musa
programme.desc: Dopo aver perso la fidanzata, Samuel Salomon, un professore, inizia a soffrire di incubi ricorrenti sull'assassinio di una donna durante un rituale. Quando questa viene trovata realmente morta nelle medesime circostanze del sogno, Salomon si addentra in un mondo oscuro dominato alle muse.

Janet si trasferisce da sola in un nuovo appartamento. La ragazza comincia ad essere vittima di allucinazioni e scopre che tra quelle quattro mura aleggia un'inquietante presenza, che la condurrà al suicidio. Lara, la sorella, decide allora di indagare sulla scomparsa della sorella...

programme.title: Shriver
programme.desc: Un tuttofare vive e lavora a New York City dove viene scambiato per uno scrittore famoso e viene portato in un'università. Qui dovrà tenere il discorso di apertura per salvare il festival letterario dell'istituto.

programme.title: 10 cose da fare prima di lasciarsi
programme.desc: Dopo che Abigail, una mamma single con due figli, rimane incinta dopo un'avventura di una notte con Ben, l'improbabile coppia cerca in tutti i modi di restare insieme. Una divertente commedia romantica con protagonista Christina Ricci.

programme.title: Anime gemelle
programme.desc: A seguito di un violento incidente d'auto, Michael si risveglia in una stanza, al cospetto di una misteriosa donna (Christina Ricci) che gli rivela che è morto e che per accedere al mondo ultraterreno dovrà completare la sua missione sulla Terra, trovare l'anima gemella. Ma trovare l'amore vero in una città caotica come New York non è certo una missione facile, tanto più se si è morti.

programme.title: Solo per l'estate
programme.desc: Cercando di eludere gli sforzi di matchmaking delle loro nonne, due ex innamorati dell'infanzia fingono di tornare insieme per l'estate.

programme.title: Il figlio desiderato
programme.desc: A seguito di un incidente successo due anni prima, Amber e Kyle sono pronti a voltare pagina. Ma il loro mondo si capovolge quando Jessica, la conducente dell'altra macchina che nell'incidente ha perso il figlio che portava in grembo, si trasferisce nella casa accanto e ottiene un lavoro con medico di Amber, alla ricerca di una fredda forma di vendetta.

programme.title: Killing your Daughter
programme.desc: Quando un test del DNA aiuta Candace a connettersi con i suoi genitori biologici, si rende conto che alcune storie familiari sono meglio lasciate inespresse.

programme.title: Scelta d'amore
programme.desc: Quando una giovane proprietaria di una caffetteria è minacciata di pignoramento, deve rischiare con la vita e l'amore mentre lotta per salvare la sua attività.

programme.title: Monte Carlo
programme.desc: Tre giovani donne in vacanza a Parigi si ritrovano catapultate a Monte Carlo dopo che una di esse viene scambiata per una ereditiera britannica.

programme.title: Una moglie ideale
programme.desc: In questo sguardo oltraggiosamente divertente al matrimonio e alla sessualità negli anni '90, un uomo felicemente sposato convince la sua amorevole moglie ad aiutarlo a vivere la fantasia maschile definitiva.

programme.title: Sabato sera, domenica mattina
programme.desc: Un operaio ribelle e dalla vita dura si destreggia tra i rapporti con due donne, una delle quali è sposata con un altro uomo ma incinta di suo figlio.

programme.title: Amore a quattro mani
programme.desc: Quando a Kacey Cooke, straordinaria food blogger con un seguito impressionante, viene offerta l'opportunità di scrivere il suo libro di cucina, la coglie al volo... L'unico problema è che in realtà non sa cucinare.

programme.title: Monte Carlo
programme.desc: A Parigi, Grace e le sue amiche sono in un albergo di lusso, quando una di loro viene scambiata per una ricca ereditiera. Neanche il tempo di chiarire, che già sono verso Monte Carlo…

programme.title: Una festa da sogno
programme.desc: L'organizzatrice di eventi di New York Kelly è una delle migliori del settore. Ma quando Joe, un influente editore di siti web, la assume per organizzare il compleanno di sua nipote, Kelly si rende conto che potrebbe aver trovato la sua anima gemella.

programme.title: Una dolce occasione
programme.desc: Dopo aver ereditato un'azienda natalizia, Kate assume Gabe Sumner per aiutarla a migliorare l'azienda. Ma non è semplice. Gabe odia il Natale e Kate odia il cambiamento, ma mentre lavorano insieme e riscoprono la magia del Natale, l'amore sboccia.

programme.title: Mozart and the whale
programme.desc: Donald e Isabel sono affetti dalla sindrome di Asperger. Gli stravolgerà la vita e lui non potrà che innamorarsene perdutamente.

programme.title: La signora Dalloway
programme.desc: Clarissa Dalloway, un'attempata signora di Londra, riflette riguardo la propria vita e sulle decisioni prese ingenuamente.

programme.title: Vendemmia d'amore
programme.desc: L'avvocato Sarah Stein si occupa di un caso riguardante un'eredità ma tutti i famigliari litigano tra di loro.

programme.title: Sotto una romantica luna
programme.desc: Quando il veterinario Eric viene chiamato da Jane per prendersi cura di una cavalla, si innamora della donna.

programme.title: Chiamatemi Helen
programme.desc: Un celebre chef affronta il percorso di transizione della figlia, nata maschio.

programme.title: Vendemmia d'amore
programme.desc: L'avvocato Sarah Stein si occupa di un caso riguardante un'eredità ma tutti i famigliari litigano tra di loro.

programme.title: Sotto una romantica luna
programme.desc: Quando il veterinario Eric viene chiamato da Jane per prendersi cura di una cavalla, si innamora della donna.

programme.title: La Rivoluzione Di Charlie
programme.desc: Charlie è un ragazzo depresso che vive con la madre. Quando si innamora di una ragazza deve fare i conti con il suo fidanzato.

programme.title: The Girl in the Book
programme.desc: Alice Harvey, ventinovenne assistente editor e aspirante scrittrice, è divertente, intelligente ed emotivamente autodistruttiva. Scalando le fila di una importante casa editrice, si sforza di scrivere la propria storia da sempre ostacolata dai ricordi della sua relazione giovanile con Milan, il miglior amico di suo padre. Dopo 15 anni, i percorsi di Alice e Milan si incrociano ancora una volta, costringendo i due a confrontarsi con eventi che sono ormai lontani.

programme.title: The Gods
programme.desc: In un moderno Romeo e Giulietta, Mikey James, un imbroglione cresciuto per strada con i suoi due fratelli, va a lavorare per la famiglia Fasano mentre cerca disperatamente di trovare una via d'uscita dal suo stile di vita frenetico.

programme.title: Gli Infedeli
programme.desc: L'infedelità maschile e le sue numerose declinazioni, viste da sette registi

programme.title: La canzone più triste del mondo
programme.desc: Durante la Grande Depressione, nella cittadina di Winnipeg, una baronessa indice un concorso per trovare la canzone più triste del mondo. Musicisti da tutto il mondo accorreranno per vincere il primo premio: 25 mila dollari. Un musical grottesco e fantastico, diretto da un grande regista, purtroppo poco conosciuto in Italia: Guy Maddin.

programme.title: E' arrivato nostro figlio
programme.desc: La storia di Aleksandra e Cyrille, una coppia parigina di primo piano, alla moda, e molto benestante, cambia completamente quando arriva nella loro casa Alekseï, un bambino russo di sette anni. Aleksandra si rende conto ben presto che questo bambino che hanno adottato non è proprio quello che aveva sperato ...

programme.title: Giuramento
programme.desc: A causa delle disastrose condizioni economiche in cui versano, Salvatore e Concetta non si possono sposare, né possono far operare la madre di lei per toglierle la cecità. per sopperire alla necessità, la donna decide di partire con il fratello Nino alla volta degli Stati Uniti per andare a chiedere ad una ricca zia. prima di partire Concetta giura eterna fedeltà a Salvatore. Ma dopo un po' di tempo l'uomo non avrà più notizie di lei. partirà cosi a sua volta per gli Stati Uniti, dove scoprirà che Concetta non ha rispettato il patto, sposandosi con un boss mafioso.

programme.title: In viaggio con Evie
programme.desc: Ben è un adolescente timido e sensibile che vive con la madre Laura, vivace bacchettona, e il padre Robert, remissivo pastore anglicano. Dopo aver messo un annuncio sul giornale parrocchiale, Ben diventa l'assistente tuttofare di Evie Walton, un'anziana attrice di teatro bizzosa e irresistibile. L'entusiasmo di Evie per la vita e per l'arte, quella letteraria, rivelerà a Ben un mondo meraviglioso che aspetta soltanto di essere vissuto.

programme.title: Rams
programme.desc: In una valle islandese isolata, Gummi e Kiddiley vivono fianco a fianco, badando al gregge di famiglia, considerato uno dei migliori del paese. I due fratelli vengono spesso premiati per le loro preziose pecore appartenenti a un ceppo antichissimo. Benché dividano la terra e conducano la stessa vita, Gummi e Kiddi non si parlano da quarant'anni. Quando una malattia letale colpisce il gregge di Kiddi, minacciando l'intera vallata, le autorità decidono di abbattere tutti gli animali della zona per contenere l'epidemia.

programme.title: Non È Un'Altra Stupida Commedia Americana
programme.desc: Questo film è una parodia delle convenzioni e i cliché del suo genere. L'esclusa della scuola, Janey Briggs (Chyler Leigh), un'aspirante artista con occhiali, coda di cavallo e una perenne salopette macchiata di pittura, è l'oggetto di una scommessa tra il giocatore di football Jake Wyler (Chris Evans) e Austin (Eric Christian Olsen) che non può essere trasformata nella “reginetta del ballo”.

programme.title: Sex Tape
programme.desc: Dopo dieci anni di matrimonio e due bambini, la relazione sessuale di Annie e Jay non è più quella di una volta. Per renderla di nuovo più viva, decidono di filmarsi mentre fanno sesso, ma poi si accorgono che il video è stato rubato …

programme.title: Only You
programme.desc: Marisa Tomei è Faith che crede fermamente negli astri e sin da ragazza una chiromante le predice che l'uomo della sua vita sarà un certo Damon Bradley. Pochi giorni prima di sposare un podologo, finalmente arriva la telefonata di Damon per farle gli augur mentre sta per partire per Venezia.

programme.title: L'asilo dei papà
programme.desc: Rimasti senza lavoro, Charlie (Eddie Murphy) e Phil (Jeff Garlin) non possono più permettersi il costoso asilo Chapman Academy.

programme.title: La governante
programme.desc: La nuova governante francese Caterina Leher sconvolge la famiglia Platania, portando caos e tragedie

programme.title: Io tigro tu tigri egli tigra
programme.desc: Film a episodi con Renato Pozzetto, Cochi Ponzoni, Paolo Villaggio ed Enrico Montesano

programme.title: Tre tigri contro tre tigri
programme.desc: Secondo film ad episodi dal cast vincente: Pozzetto, Cochi, Villaggio e Montesano

programme.title: Mi faccia causa
programme.desc: Davanti al pretore Giovanni Pennisi transita tutti i giorni un campionario di varia umanità,

programme.title: La donna più bella del mondo
programme.desc: Gina Lollobrigida interpreta una donna affascinante e ambiziosa che cerca di farsi strada nel mondo dello spettacolo. Tra amori e tradimenti, la sua bellezza diventa sia un vantaggio che una trappola, esplorando la superficialità e le difficoltà della fama.

programme.title: Anni difficili
programme.desc: Con Umberto Spadaro, Massimo Girotti e Ave Ninchi, Aldo Piscitello deve aderire al Partito Fascista e affrontare la guerra. Tra doveri familiari e scelte morali, cerca il coraggio di restare fedele a sé stesso in un'Italia in crisi.

programme.title: Accadde al penitenziario
programme.desc: In un penitenziario, le disavventure di un gruppo di detenuti e delle loro relazioni con il personale, tra situazioni comiche e paradossali, creando un mix di risate e riflessioni sulla vita dietro le sbarre.

programme.title: Vita da cani
programme.desc: Le vite di diversi personaggi si intrecciano in un susseguirsi di difficoltà quotidiane e situazioni comiche. Aldo Fabrizi, Gina Lollobrigida e Marcello Mastroianni sono protagonisti di una commedia che racconta le piccole disavventure della vita, con ironia e causticità.

programme.title: Date and Switch
programme.desc: Michael e Matty, studenti dell'ultimo anno delle superiori, sono amici del cuore dalle elementari. Sono ancora vergini, così decidono di fare un patto per aiutarsi a vicenda ad avere il loro primo rapporto prima del ballo di fine anno.

programme.title: Project A
programme.desc: Hong Kong, 1800. Mentre gli inglesi sono occupati a governare le terre, i pirati sono i padroni dei mari facendo razzie delle imbarcazioni che incontrano. Nonostante vari tentativi la Guardia Costiera non riesce a sconfiggerli.

programme.title: Bibo per sempre
programme.desc: Un attore della televisione incontra un mendicante che mostra amore a tutti coloro che lo circondano e lo ispira ad apprezzare di più la vita.

programme.title: Guess Who
programme.desc: Quando Theresa porta il fidanzato Simon Green a casa per il 25° anniversario di matrimonoi dei genitori, dimentica di menzionare un piccolo dettaglio, è bianco. Deciso a rompere il fidanzamento di sua figlia, Percy Jones ci dimostra che i padri non sono sempre saggi.

programme.title: Un tavolo per due
programme.desc: Leigh gestisce il sito web "Bad Date Chronicles". Quando il blogger rivale Conner diventa il soggetto di uno dei suoi post, i due decidono di uscire insieme per vedere chi dei due è il "cattivo frequentatore".

programme.title: Big Baby
programme.desc: Uno scienziato inventa una macchina che agisce sui geni e trasforma il nipote di quattro anni in un adulto. Quando Bobby scappa di casa, i suoi fratelli devono riuscire a trovarlo prima del ritorno dei genitori. Il tempo stringe, rimane un solo giorno!

programme.title: Ti presento Bill
programme.desc: Stufo della sua vita, Bill si ritrova mentore di un adolescente indisciplinato ma curiosamente saggio. Quando scopre il tradimento della moglie, Bill non ha più nulla da perdere e si rivolge al ragazzo come modello di ispirazione per cambiare esistenza.

programme.title: Company Man
programme.desc: Per evitare la moglie petulante, un insegnante si finge agente segreto della CIA e viene reclutato per rovesciare la dittatura di Fidel Castro a Cuba.

programme.title: I complessi
programme.desc: Quirino cerca di conquistare Gabriella, amante di Alvaro, con la complessità della timidezza.

programme.title: Buckaroo: Il winchester che non perdona
programme.desc: Dopo aver accettato di uccidere un amico per salvarsi durante un attacco, Lash arriva in un villaggio al confine messicano per impossessarsi di una miniera. Con astuzia e violenza, diventa il padrone della zona. Ma l'arrivo di Buckaroo, giovane domatore che lavora per Johnny, innesca una resa dei conti finale che elimina Lash e i suoi alleati.

programme.title: Sapevano solo uccidere
programme.desc: Una banda messicana guidata da Pedro semina terrore tra New Mexico e Arizona. Jeff, giovane il cui padre è stato ucciso da Pedro, parte alla ricerca di vendetta, determinato a fermare il tiranno e porre fine alla violenza che ha devastato la sua terra.

programme.title: Una pistola per cento croci!
programme.desc: Dopo che un irlandese viene ucciso nel West, suo figlio Jimmy cerca vendetta ma viene ucciso a sua volta. Django (o Sartana) scopre la verità tramite una lettera della sorella di Jimmy, Jessica, e parte alla ricerca degli assassini. Tra rapimenti, torture e scontri, Django cerca giustizia, giustificando le cento croci sulla sua pistola.

programme.title: La valle dell'oro
programme.desc: Mason viene accusato dell'omicidio del socio Benson dopo un'imboscata nella miniera. Ma Benson, creduto morto, è vivo e ha un piano per smascherare i veri colpevoli durante il processo che potrebbe condannare Mason.

programme.title: Buon funerale amigos!... paga Sartana
programme.desc: Dopo un brutale massacro, Sartana arriva a Indian Creek deciso a scoprire la verità. Quasi tutti sembrano voler mettere le mani sulle proprietà delle vittime, e chiunque potrebbe essere l'assassino. Con uno sceriffo poco affidabile e troppi sospetti, Sartana deve trovare da solo il colpevole nascosto tra loro.

programme.title: Lo credevano uno stinco di santo
programme.desc: Un gruppo di fuorilegge sono in cerca del tesoro nascosto di un vecchio prigioniero: solo uno lo troverà

programme.title: I quattro inesorabili
programme.desc: Quattro cacciatori di taglie del Texas cercano vendetta contro un ranger che ha scagionato il loro ricercato.

programme.title: Sette ore di fuoco
programme.desc: Buffalo Bill guida una carovana di pionieri e affronta una banda di contrabbandieri che vende armi ai Sioux.

programme.title: Tutto per tutto
programme.desc: A El Paso, l'indiano Faccia di Rame cerca vendetta contro il ladro Carranza per l'oro rubato.

programme.title: L'ombra di Zorro
programme.desc: I fratelli Billy e Dan vanno in California per uccidere Zorro e vendicare la morte del loro fratello.

programme.desc: Vivi i momenti iconici e l'eredità dei più grandi stilisti del '900 che hanno rivoluzionato la moda.

programme.title: I See You
programme.desc: Una famiglia apparentemente perfetta viene messa alla prova dai fantasmi che la perseguitano.

programme.title: Affairs of State
